data.value: Only fill in if the texture should have its real size; textures.com states it, 20 × 20 cm is 0.2. At real size, a fine texture can blur into a single colour from the game camera.

data.value: {0}.sdmat already exists: the Id stays, the content is rewritten.

data.value: Done. Game Studio does not reload changed files on its own: reload the project.

data.name: Settings_LibraryHint
data.value: One subfolder per set, with the original downloads.

data.name: Settings_DownloadsHint
data.value: This is where the inbox looks for new sets, loose and in zips.

data.name: Settings_LanguageHint
data.value: Without a translation for the Windows language, Material Depot is in English. A change takes effect after a restart.

data.name: Settings_PatternsHint
data.value: Regular expressions that match the file name without extension, regardless of case; the first matching pattern applies. The named groups (?<name>…) for the set and (?<map>…) for the map are required, (?<res>…) for the resolution is optional.

data.name: Settings_MapNamesHint
data.value: What the map is called in file names, separated by commas. Case, spaces, hyphens and underscores do not count.

data.name: Settings_ProjectsHint
data.value: Source images and asset folder relative to the project folder, textures and materials relative to the asset folder.

data.value: Remove project “{0}” from the list? Nothing changes in the project itself.

data.value: At least one file name pattern is needed.

data.value: A file name pattern is invalid. Please correct it, then save.

data.name: Settings_SavedRestart

data.name: Setup_SkipToolTip
data.value: Start with the defaults; the setup can be opened again in the settings

data.name: Setup_LibraryIntro
data.value: The library is the folder in which every texture set gets a subfolder of its own with the original files.

data.name: Setup_DownloadsIntro
data.value: This is where the inbox looks for new sets, loose and in zip files. Usually this is the download folder of the browser.

data.name: Setup_ProjectIntro
data.value: For the import into Stride, Material Depot needs a project. You can also add one later in the settings.

data.name: Setup_SourceImagesToolTip
data.value: Relative to the project folder; the PNGs go here, one subfolder per set

data.name: Setup_AssetFolderToolTip
data.value: Relative to the project folder; the Assets folder of the Stride package

data.name: Setup_FlowIntro
data.value: This is how you work with Material Depot:

data.name: Setup_Flow1
data.value: Download a set. The inbox finds new sets in the download folder, also in zip files.

data.name: Setup_Flow2
data.value: The original files move into a folder of their own per set. The library shows every set with its albedo as preview.

data.name: Setup_Flow3
data.value: A set can be imported into a project. Material Depot writes the PNGs, the textures and the finished material.

data.name: Setup_Flow4
data.value: Game Studio does not reload changed files on its own. Reload the project after an import.

data.name: Setup_ReopenHint
data.value: The setup can be opened again at any time in the settings.
